authoring_rationale: Class B, boundary adversary (a difference in something that is not a recognised governed property). The variants differ in the chosen reminder sound (wooden chime versus low bell) and page colour (dusk blue versus sand), and in layout. Reminder sound and page colour are display preferences, not any of the nine recognised properties, and no disposition may rest on them. All nine properties checked: authority (the member changes their own preferences), permission and boundary crossing (the steward sees that a change happened, not the values), persistence and memory treatment (kept twelve months in the settings history), attribution (changed by the member on the fifth) same; provenance, decision status and review state not engaged. Surface features varied: formatting, phrasing. Checked that no_governance_delta is reachable from the visible text alone.
